attributes.description:
Fan Sphere is the social home for sports fans. Watch games together in public or private watch parties, capture and share unforgettable moments, follow your       
  favorite teams across every league, and join the community that loves sports as much as you do.

  WATCH TOGETHER
  • Public watch parties — RSVP and join fellow fans for any game
  • Private watch parties — invite your crew, no strangers
  • Live chat inside every party as the action unfolds

  YOUR TEAMS, YOUR FEED
  • Follow teams across NBA, NFL, MLB, soccer leagues, college sports, and more
  • Personalized scores, clips, and game alerts for the teams you care about
  • Year-round coverage — every season, every sport

  CAPTURE & SHARE
  • Record game-day clips in seconds
  • Share directly to TikTok and Instagram with one tap
  • Build your following as a sports creator

  FAN GROUPS
  • Join unlimited fan groups for any team or interest
  • Live chat with fellow members anytime
  • Find your people, build your community

 SOCCER CUP 2026
  • Dedicated Soccer Cup tab covering every match
  • Available with Premium or the one-time WC Pass

  PREMIUM
  Fan Sphere Premium unlocks unlimited watch parties, advanced clip tools, and the Soccer Cup 2026 tab. Try free for 7 days. $9.99/month or $107.99/year (save 10%).  
  Soccer Cup Pass available as one-time $19.99 purchase.

  Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions in your App Store account settings.

  Privacy Policy: https://fansphere.org/privacy/
  Terms: https://fansphere.org/terms/
  Support: support@thabtech.com
attributes.promotionalText: Watch every game with friends. Join public watch parties, create private ones with your crew, share clips to TikTok & Instagram, follow your teams across all Sports.
